newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ chief economist Mayes ending contract.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ chief economist Mayes ending contract.

text.p: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Chief Economist David Mayes is leaving the bank in April when his contract expires, spokesman Paul Jackman said on Thursday.
The position will be advertised shortly. The bank could not say immediately who will be acting chief economist.
The senior researcher with the economics department, Tim Ng, has been seconded to Treasurer Winston Peters.
Darren Gibbs, advisor with the Economics Department, has also been seconded, to the Inflation and Military Policy section of the U.K. Treasury.
